Bearer.description:
For accessing the API a valid JWT token must be passed in all requests in
the 'Authorization' header.


A valid JWT token is generated by the Authorization API and returned as answer of a call
to the route /authenticate giving a valid user, password & universe.


The following syntax must be used in the 'Authorization' header :

    Bearer xxxxxx.yyyyyyy.zzzzzz
